rationale.usefulness: Generation, reference editing, layout guidance, API pricing and local workflow instructions form a practical asset-production toolkit. The original lesson, museum-site and storyboard proposals include sensible acceptance checks and correctly separate image assets from application behavior and video motion.
rationale.impact: Downloadable generation and editing checkpoints with multi-reference layout control and an optimized consumer-GPU route could substantially widen creative model deployment. Impact remains domain-level: quality, speed and memory figures are vendor measurements and implementation-dependent.
rationale.novelty: Combining up to ten references, bounding-box guidance, adaptation through Base and inference through Distilled is meaningful differentiation. The evidence supports a useful integrated capability rather than a fundamentally new image-generation paradigm.
rationale.maturity: Model cards, reference code, API contracts and ComfyUI templates are substantive readiness signals. The young release still has prompt-expansion requirements, imperfect regional preservation and sharply different memory profiles, with no independent generation or production test here.
rationale.openness: Weights, reference code and adaptation guidance improve inspectability and portability. The weight license is conditional, revocable and restricted, with a qualifying revenue threshold and limits on commercial activities and improving similar models. Apache-licensed code does not make the weights unrestricted.

concerns: Nonblocking: The eight-gigabyte route is specific to optimized ComfyUI INT8 execution; reference memory figures and prompt expansion must remain separately qualified.
Nonblocking: Bounding boxes are guidance rather than hard masks, and hosted pixel restoration must not be generalized to local checkpoints.
Nonblocking: Commercial output rights and commercial training or distribution rights are distinct under the inspected license; the report preserves that distinction.
